description: Join our walk to explore the hidden enclaves around London Bridge. Discover the secrets of the riverside and some of Southwark’s lesser-known historic corners. We’ll learn how businesses and residents within this diverse enclave, in a former industrial neighbourhood, are joining forces in response to a changing climate in the bid to reach Net Zero.

events.name: Creative Connections - London Bridge walking tour.
events.notes: A roughly circular walk in the London Bridge area with a focus on history, art, architecture, nature and surprising hidden corners.

factsheet.heading: Hidden heritage, secret art and surprising green spaces
paragraphs:
There's much more than meets the eye around London Bridge. 
And 2026 marks the 20th year that local business improvement district Team London Bridge has helped make this area safer, greener, cleaner - and a better place to live, work, study and visit.  
Our walking tour explores some of the progress made since 2006 to make the London Bridge locale a more pleasant, liveable and loveable neighbourhood, focusing on those human factors that inspire passion in all of us about where we live. In addition to art in unexpected places, and clues to an industrial past, London Bridge boasts beautiful green spaces. And we will explore its bold and innovative approaches to a changing climate, building healthy streets,  embracing climate adaptability and promoting overall resilience.
